description: Classification of all 1197 EPTP checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 26 EPTP guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.crz-radius-calculation: CRZ radius must be calculated from tree diameter (radius in feet = diameter in inches)
additionalRequirementTypes.area-calculation: Area calculation required (percentage, square footage, acreage)
additionalRequirementTypes.construction-detail-verification: Construction details must be verified (excavation widths, depths, over-excavation)
additionalRequirementTypes.grading-verification: Grade change depth must be verified against thresholds
additionalRequirementTypes.species-verification: Tree species must be confirmed (heritage, utility-compatible, post oak, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.heritage-tree-verification: Heritage tree status must be confirmed (24+ DBH of designated species)
additionalRequirementTypes.city-arborist-approval: City Arborist approval or determination required
additionalRequirementTypes.canopy-assessment: Canopy/pruning assessment required to determine crown removal percentage
additionalRequirementTypes.vegetation-specification: Vegetation type, count, or species must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.cef-identification: Critical Environmental Feature must be identified and buffer measured
additionalRequirementTypes.cwqz-boundary-verification: CWQZ boundary location must be verified based on watershed classification
additionalRequirementTypes.drainage-area-verification: Drainage area size must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.activity-identification: Construction activity type must be identified
additionalRequirementTypes.excavation-method-specification: Excavation method must be specified (low-impact, boring, hand-digging)
additionalRequirementTypes.root-avoidance-specification: Root avoidance protocol must be specified
additionalRequirementTypes.structural-design-verification: Structural design must be verified for spanning or clearance
additionalRequirementTypes.planting-size-verification: Planting container size must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.iwm-compliance-verification: IWM undisturbed area compliance must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.root-zone-assessment: Root zone connectivity must be assessed
additionalRequirementTypes.staging-area-identification: Staging area location must be identified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.spoils-area-identification: Spoils area location must be identified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.dumpster-placement-verification: Dumpster placement must be verified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.access-route-verification: Access route must be verified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.portable-toilet-placement: Portable toilet placement must be verified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.washout-area-verification: Washout area placement must be verified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.equipment-identification: Equipment type and turning radius must be identified
additionalRequirementTypes.fencing-verification: Fencing location and extent must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.fencing-specification: Fencing specifications must be verified (height, spacing, material)
additionalRequirementTypes.sight-distance-verification: Sight distance triangle must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.site-improvement-verification: Site improvement locations must be verified for conflicts
additionalRequirementTypes.design-modification: Design modification required for preservation compliance
additionalRequirementTypes.mature-size-verification: Plant mature size must be verified for clearance
